description: This file defines ONNX export symbolic functions for PyTorch operators specific to opset 14, including custom implementations of operators like hardswish, tril, triu, reshape, batch_norm, quantized_hardswish, and scaled_dot_product_attention. It maps PyTorch operations to their ONNX representations to enable conversion.

methods.name: hardswish(g: jit_utils.GraphContext, self)
methods.description: Defines the symbolic implementation of the HardSwish operator for ONNX export.

methods.name: tril(g: jit_utils.GraphContext, self, diagonal, out=None)
methods.description: Defines the symbolic implementation of the tril operator for ONNX export.

methods.name: triu(g: jit_utils.GraphContext, self, diagonal, out=None)
methods.description: Defines the symbolic implementation of the triu operator for ONNX export.

methods.name: reshape(g: jit_utils.GraphContext, self, shape)
methods.description: Defines the symbolic implementation of the reshape operator, with a note about ONNX Runtime bugs.

methods.name: batch_norm( g: jit_utils.GraphContext, input, weight, bias, running_mean, running_var, training, momentum, eps, cudnn_enabled, )
methods.description: Defines the symbolic implementation of the batch normalization operator with support for training mode and fallback checks.

methods.name: quantized_hardswish(g: jit_utils.GraphContext, x, op_scale, op_zero_point)
methods.description: Defines the quantized symbolic implementation of the HardSwish operator, including dequantization and quantization steps.

methods.name: scaled_dot_product_attention( g: jit_utils.GraphContext, query: torch._C.Value, key: torch._C.Value, value: torch._C.Value, attn_mask: torch._C.Value | None = None, dropout_p: float = 0.0, is_causal: bool = False, scale: torch._C.Value | None = None, enable_gqa: bool = False, )
methods.description: Defines the symbolic implementation of scaled dot product attention, including optional masking, causal handling, and axis transposition.
